quote: We assess the model's performance by evaluating its final prediction using the Exact Match (EM) criteria . This evaluation considers four key metrics: 1) #Turns, which represents the average number of turns taken to complete the game. Games terminate at 20 turns if failed. Lower is better. 2) Success rate, which indicates the percentage of games won by G. Higher is better. 3) #Yes, which represents the average number of "yes" responses received from the J. 4) Score, which is a combined game score of #Turns and success rate, defined in Eq. (1).
